popup.title: OGP Dev Tool
popup.openDevtools: Open DevTools → OGP tab to inspect OGP metadata.

tips.ogUrl: Page URL — must be an absolute URL.
tips.ogType: Content type: website, article, blog, product, etc.
tips.ogTitle: Page title, usually without the site name.
tips.ogLocale: Language and territory of content, e.g. en_US or ja_JP.
tips.ogImage: Thumbnail image URL (absolute). 1200×630 px or larger recommended.
tips.ogImageSecureUrl: HTTPS URL for the image (used when the page is served over HTTPS).
tips.ogImageType: MIME type of the image, e.g. image/jpeg or image/png.
tips.ogImageAlt: Alt text for the image, used by screen readers and when the image fails to load.
tips.twitterCard: X card type: summary, summary_large_image, app, or player.
tips.twitterTitle: Title for the X card. Overrides og:title when set.
tips.twitterDescription: Description for the X card. Overrides og:description when set.
tips.twitterImage: Image URL for the X card. Overrides og:image when set.
tips.fbAppId: Facebook App ID. Must be registered at Meta for Developers.
tips.articleAuthor: Profile URL of the article author.
tips.articleSection: Category or section name of the article.
